cases.translation: The land of Egypt is before you.
cases.explain: Земля is the grammatical subject of the sentence, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: They received a fixed portion from Pharaoh.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Иосиф сказал ___, «Теперь, когда я купил вас и вашу землю для фараона, вот вам семена, чтобы засеять землю».
cases.translation: Joseph said to the people, 'Now that I have bought you and your land for Pharaoh, here is seed for you to sow the land.'
cases.explain: The verb сказал (said) takes its indirect object (to whom) in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Если я нашел расположение в твоих глазах, положи ___ мне под бедро и обещай, что явишь мне милость и верность.
cases.translation: If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise to show me kindness and faithfulness.
cases.explain: The transitive verb положи (put) takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иосиф обеспечил ___ отца и братьев и весь свой род.
cases.translation: Joseph provided his father and brothers and all his household with food.
cases.explain: The verb обеспечил (provided) governs the instrumental case for the thing supplied.

cases.sentence: Иаков прожил в ___ 17 лет, так что всего он жил 147 лет.
cases.translation: Jacob lived in Egypt 17 years, so that in all he lived 147 years.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Мой отец и братья со своими стадами крупного и мелкого скота и всем имуществом пришли из земли Ханаана и сейчас находятся в Гошене».
reading.question: What did Joseph tell Pharaoh about his family?
options: They had arrived from Canaan and were now in Goshen
They had died in the famine
They refused to come to Egypt
They wanted to return to Canaan immediately
reading.correct: They had arrived from Canaan and were now in Goshen
reading.explain: Joseph tells Pharaoh his father and brothers came from Canaan and are now in Goshen.

reading.question: What did Pharaoh ask Joseph's brothers?
options: Why did you come to Egypt?
reading.explain: Pharaoh asks the brothers what their occupation is.

reading.ru: Иаков ответил фараону, «Дней моего странствования сто тридцать лет.
reading.question: How old did Jacob say he was when he met Pharaoh?
reading.explain: Jacob tells Pharaoh the days of his pilgrimage have been 130 years.

reading.ru: Иосиф собрал все деньги, какие только были в Египте и Ханаане, в уплату за зерно, которое у него покупали.
reading.question: What did Joseph collect in exchange for grain during the famine?
options: All the money in Egypt and Canaan
reading.correct: All the money in Egypt and Canaan
reading.explain: Joseph gathered all the money in Egypt and Canaan in payment for grain.

reading.ru: Иосиф сказал, «Приведите свой скот, а я дам вам хлеба в обмен на него, раз у вас кончились деньги».
reading.question: What did Joseph offer to trade for bread once the people's money ran out?
reading.explain: Joseph tells them to bring their livestock and he will give them bread in exchange.

reading.ru: Купи нас и нашу землю в обмен на хлеб, а мы с нашей землей будем в рабстве у фараона
reading.question: What did the Egyptians offer to sell in exchange for bread when even their livestock was gone?
reading.explain: The Egyptians offer to sell themselves and their land in exchange for bread.

reading.ru: Он не купил только землю жрецов, потому что они получали постоянную долю от фараона
reading.question: Whose land did Joseph not buy during the famine?
reading.explain: Joseph did not buy the priests' land, since they received a fixed portion from Pharaoh.

reading.ru: Когда поспеет урожай, отдайте одну пятую от него фараону, а остальные четыре пятых будут вам
reading.question: What portion of the harvest did Joseph's law require to be given to Pharaoh?
reading.explain: Joseph's law required one fifth of the harvest to be given to Pharaoh.

reading.ru: Иаков прожил в Египте 17 лет, так что всего он жил 147 лет.
reading.question: How many total years did Jacob live?
reading.explain: The text states Jacob lived a total of 147 years.

reading.ru: Не хорони меня в Египте, но когда я сойду к моим отцам, вынеси меня из Египта и похорони там, где похоронены они».
reading.question: What request did Jacob make of Joseph near the end of his life?
options: To be buried with his ancestors, not in Egypt
To free all the Egyptian slaves
To divide his land among all his sons immediately
reading.correct: To be buried with his ancestors, not in Egypt
reading.explain: Jacob asks Joseph not to bury him in Egypt, but to carry him out and bury him with his ancestors.
